summary: Inovio Pharmaceuticals filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten follow-on offering of 58,747,235 common shares plus pre-funded warrants for 12,681,337 shares at $1.05 per share ($1.049 per pre-funded warrant), for gross proceeds of ~$74.99M and net proceeds of ~$70.49M before expenses. The November 5, 2026 pricing sits below the $1.45 November 5 close, implying roughly a 28% discount. Jefferies and Piper Sandler are joint book-runners, H.C. Wainwright lead manager, with a 30-day option for 10,714,285 additional shares; closing expected November 9, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and warrant overhang.
